verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair axis for a KYC/identity-verification SaaS that stores applicant data, but no evidence item mentions choosing a storage region or data residency. The pack covers the API, sandbox, webhooks, SDK customization, team access and SSO, none of which concern where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
